title: Pip and Tumble's Super Helper Week
moral: When we help at home, everyone in the family feels happy.
description: Nana Hoot is so busy with chores that she falls asleep standing up! So Pip and Tumble promise to be her helpers for one whole week. Learn the seven days of the week, from Monday to Sunday, in this funny animated story full of sneezes, splooshes and bubbles, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: One sunny Sunday, Nana Hoot was SO busy with chores that... zzzz! She fell asleep standing up! And her glasses went slip... slip... SLIP!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm awake!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana, you need a rest! Tumble and I will help you for one whole week! That's a hundred days! Super-duper!
Hee-hee! Not a hundred, Pip! How many days are in one week? Do YOU know?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Seven! A week has seven days. Hoo-hoo-HOO! And the first helping day is... Monday!

narration.text: MONDAY! Day one! Pip grabbed the broom and swept super fast. Swish, swish, swish!
Round and round he spun until... wibble-wobble! He was so dizzy, he went BONK, right into the cupboard!
And all that dust? It tickled Tumble's trunk. Uh-oh... you know what happens next, don't you?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOOO!
WHOOOOSH! Every speck of dust flew right out of the door! The floor was sparkly clean!
TUESDAY! Day two! Time to water Nana's garden. Tumble filled his trunk at the pond. Sluuuurp!
Squirt number one... SPLOOSH! Right on Pip's head! Squirt number two... SPLOOSH! Right on Pip's tail!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tumble! I'm a fox, not a flower!
Squirt number three... sprinkle, sprinkle! Right on the flowers at last! Hooray!
Then Tumble flapped his big ears to dry Pip. Flap, flap... FLOOF! Now Pip looked like a fluffy dandelion!
The next morning... which day comes after Tuesday? Can you guess?
WEDNESDAY! You got it! Day three is washing day!
Pip pegged up the socks, one by one. Then a big breeze blew... and a stripy sock landed, PLOP, right on Tumble's trunk!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! My trunk is wearing a sock!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! That's the silliest sock hanger I ever saw!

narration.text: I know what comes after Wednesday! It's... Snooze-day!

narration.speaker: nana

Hee-hee! Silly Pip! It's not Snooze-day. It's THURSDAY! Day four, apple picking day!

narration.text: FRIDAY! Day five, dish washing day! Tumble blew into the soapy water... and out came bubbles! Hundreds of bubbles!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Look! A bubble on my nose! Bloop!
Pip washed the cups. Tumble dried the plates. Scrub, scrub, squeak, squeak! Every dish was shiny clean.
Then they did a happy bubble dance. Wiggle, wiggle... POP!
SATURDAY! Day six! But Pip and Tumble were very, very tired.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: My paws are all floppy. Maybe we can skip today?
Just then, they saw Nana carrying a big, heavy basket of leaves. Wibble... wobble... wibble!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Nana, let us carry that! Helpers help, even on floppy days!
So Pip raked and Tumble carried, and soon the whole yard was neat and tidy. Nana gave them the biggest hug!
SUNDAY! Day seven, the very last day of the week! And guess what? Nana had a surprise!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Thank you, my little helpers! I rested all week, so tonight I made pancakes for YOU!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Pancakes! HONK, HONK, HOORAY!
Everybody danced under the twinkly lanterns. Even Nana! Hoo-hoo-HOO!

narration.text: Let's remember! How many days are in one week?
Seven! You're so smart!
And which day comes right after Monday?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tuesday! Let's say them all! Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: We did it! HONK!
That night, Nana's little house was clean and cosy, and everybody felt warm and happy inside.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Helping at home is super-duper! Let's help again next week, Tumble!
Nana tried to say goodnight... but zzzz... her glasses went slip, slip, SLIP!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! Goodnight, my helpers!
